summary_1line: Anshuman searches underground, finds the sacrificial horse and his uncles’ ashes, and learns their rites require the sacred waters of the Ganga.

image_candidates.scene_text: Prince Anshuman stands in a cavern before a mound of ash that was once his uncles, while the sacrificial horse grazes nearby.
Anshuman bows respectfully before a colossal guardian elephant deep within the earth as it blesses his quest.
The sacred eagle Garuda appears before the grieving prince and tells him the ashes can only be purified by the waters of the Ganga.
